items.exampleEn: The weather is usually warmer in the south.
items.exampleZh: 南部的天氣通常比較溫暖。

items.exampleEn: The sun goes down in the west.
Hualien is on the east coast of Taiwan.
Which direction is the station in?
We visited the capital last summer.
items.exampleZh: 我們去年夏天去了首都。

items.exampleEn: There is only one shop in our village.
items.exampleZh: 我們村子裡只有一家商店。

items.exampleEn: My teacher's native country is Canada.
items.exampleZh: 我老師的母國是加拿大。

items.exampleEn: This is a quiet zone. Please don't talk loudly.
items.exampleZh: 這裡是安靜區，請不要大聲說話。

items.sentenceEn: Drive west for about ten minutes.

items.audioEn: The village is about thirty minutes east of the city.
items.audioZh: 那個村莊在城市東邊，大約三十分鐘的路程。

items.sentenceEn: Drive slowly in the school zone.
items.sentenceZh: 在學校周邊區域請慢慢開。

items.sentenceEn: Many young people moved from the village to the capital.
items.sentenceZh: 很多年輕人從村莊搬到了首都。

items.passageEn: Amy grew up in a small village in the south of Taiwan. When she was eighteen, she moved north to study in a big city. At first, she often got lost because she had no sense of direction. Now she works in an office in the east of the city. But every Chinese New Year, she goes back to her village.
items.passageZh: Amy 在台灣南部的一個小村莊長大。十八歲時，她搬到北部的大城市讀書。一開始她常常迷路，因為她完全沒有方向感。現在她在城市東區的一間辦公室工作。不過每年過年，她都會回到她的村莊。

questions.questionZh: Amy 一開始為什麼常常迷路？

referenceEn: Seoul is the capital of Korea.
The capital of Korea is Seoul.
rubricZh: 「⋯的首都」可寫 the capital of＋國家

items.promptZh: 那輛車往另一個方向開走了。
referenceEn: That car went in the other direction.
The car drove off in the other direction.
rubricZh: 「往…方向」可寫，例如 in the other direction、in the opposite direction 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 went、drove off、has gone 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似：「Which direction is the station?」口語勉強可通，但較道地是 "Which direction is the station in?" 或 "Which way is the station?"；當單字卡範例宜用標準句。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Which direction is the station in?"（原 "Which direction is the station?"）；照建議改標準句

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關："Can you tell me the direction to the museum?" 不道地：問路要用 directions（複數，指路線說明）或 the way to；單數 the direction to 是錯誤示範。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Is the museum in this direction?"（原 "Can you tell me the direction to the museum?"）；the direction to 不道地，改用 in this direction 問路

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：「「往這個方向」用 in this direction」寫死；Go this direction（美式常見）也正確，且題目不一定要寫「往這個方向」；建議改「例如 in this direction、the wrong direction」並不作必要條件。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "介系詞可寫例如 in this direction、in the wrong direction（寫 go this direction 也可以）"（原 "「往這個方向」用 in this direction"）；改成「例如」，不當必要條件

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似：「the business zone」不自然，一般說 business district／business area；zone 搭配宜改用 quiet zone、time zone 等常見用法。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Amy grew up in a small village in the south of Taiwan. When she was eighteen, she moved north to study in a big city. At first, she often got lost because she had no sense of direction. Now she works in an office in the east of the city. But every New Year, she goes back to her village."（原 "Amy grew up in a small village in the south of Taiwan. When she was eighteen, she moved north to study in a big city. At first, she often got lost because she had no sense of direction. Now she works in the business zone in the east of the city. But every New Year, she goes back to her village."）；business zone 不自然；zone 改在 q11 跟讀句用常見搭配
